insurer_name: Bajaj Allianz General Insurance Co. Ltd.

inpatient_hospitalization.notes: Worldwide in-patient hospitalization (Imperial / Imperial Plus plans). Domestic plan limits to India.

organ_donor_expenses.notes: Organ transplant cover including donor expenses; international transplant covered

ambulance_cover.notes: Road ambulance + air ambulance for emergency evacuation

preventive_health_checkup.notes: Annual comprehensive health check-up; tests scale with SI

maternity_coverage.notes: Maternity cover with 24-month waiting period; covers normal and C-section; newborn cover from Day 1

newborn_coverage.notes: From Day 1; vaccination cover up to 18 years

modern_treatments.notes: 12 modern treatments per IRDAI plus extensive coverage for international standard treatments

restoration_benefit.notes: Unlimited reinstatement / restoration of Sum Insured

no_claim_bonus_notes: Super NCB up to 100% of base SI

worldwide_emergency_cover.notes: Worldwide hospitalization including USA / Canada (Imperial Plus) or worldwide excluding USA/Canada (Imperial). Includes emergency hospitalization, planned hospitalization abroad, evacuation, repatriation, second medical opinion.

notable_exclusions_summary: Bajaj Allianz Global Health Care - premium high-SI worldwide product. Two plans: Imperial (worldwide excluding USA/Canada) and Imperial Plus (worldwide including USA/Canada). SI options Rs 1Cr-100Cr. Comprehensive coverage including maternity, newborn, modern treatments, mental health, dental and vision (Plus variant). Reduces PED to 24 months. Premium higher than domestic plans.
claim_process_summary: Cashless via worldwide network (international claims via assistance partner). Pre-auth within 24 hours for planned, immediate for emergency. Reimbursement via app/email; documents within 30 days. Settlement in INR (or original currency for international claims as per RBI rates).
